content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for CPRI Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates having the required educational qualification can apply for different posts. The eligibility details are as follows: Engineering Officer Gr. I: Candidates with relevant Engineering Degree qualification as per post requirement. Engineering Assistant: Candidates with relevant Diploma qualification in the required discipline. Scientific Assistant: Candidates with relevant Science qualification. Technician Gr. I: Candidates with ITI qualification in relevant trade. Technical Attendant / Multi-Tasking Staff: Candidates with required qualification as mentioned in the official notification. Assistant Gr. II: Candidates with required qualification as per CPRI rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CPRI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official CPRI website. Open the recruitment/career section. Read the official notification carefully. Click on the online application link. Complete the registration process. Fill in the required details in the application form. Upload required documents. Submit the application form and take a printout for future reference.
